title_en: Act amending banking laws in response to advances in information and communications technology
title_ja: 情報通信技術の進展等の環境変化に対応するための銀行法等の一部を改正する法律
summary_en: Act No. 62 of 2016 amends the Banking Act and other laws to address changes including advances in information and communications technology. This listing concerns its amendment of the Long-Term Credit Bank Act (Act No. 187 of 1952), with a stated promulgation date of 2016-06-03 and effective date of 2017-04-01.
business_impact_en: Long-term credit banks may be affected by the amendments to the Long-Term Credit Bank Act; the listing does not describe the specific changes or their operational implications.
recommended_action_en: Review the official Japanese source for the amended provisions of the Long-Term Credit Bank Act and any transitional provisions associated with the stated effective date.
source_name: e-Gov Law Search (法令更新一覧)
ai_notes: Based on the title and structured metadata, not the substantive provisions; this unofficial English summary must be verified against the authoritative Japanese source.

zh-Hans.title: 《为应对信息通信技术进步等环境变化而部分修订银行法等的法律》
zh-Hans.summary: 2016年第62号法律修订《银行法》等法律，以应对包括信息通信技术进步在内的变化。本条目涉及该法律对《长期信用银行法》（1952年第187号法律）的修订，所载公布日期为2016-06-03，生效日期为2017-04-01。
zh-Hans.business_impact: 长期信用银行可能受到《长期信用银行法》修订的影响；本条目未说明具体变更及其对业务运营的影响。
zh-Hans.recommended_action: 建议查阅日文官方来源，了解《长期信用银行法》的修订条文以及与所载生效日期相关的过渡条款。
